title: Swimlane glossary → SKOS concept scheme
description: How scripts/glossary-export.ts defines the glossary document, which IS the concept scheme. Its NAME is not here: since bean lodp (finding D1) the scheme is named by the shared table concept-scheme-naming, which declares the sl9u condition (a concept scheme that is also a document carries a derived dcterms:title) once for every emitter. Inventory row 15 of docs/proposals/vocabulary-mappings-2026-10-02.md.
